input.china_demand: A pausable real-time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. input.china_demand: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you… A deadly virus has broken out, and the town is swarming with zombies. Police partners, Olivenia and Noah, receive a mission to escort a Special Agent to a secret base. Noah guides her from the computer room while Olivenia fights the zombies on her own. Along the way, she uncovers information about another survivor, Beatrice, as well as a mysterious biological weapon. Will Olivenia be able to find Beatrice and survive the zombie outbreak? Or will she have a one-sided dance with the enemies while Noah may or may not be listening in the background? Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined is a rogue-lite exploration RPG/ADV set in a city infected by a zombie virus. It combines action and strategy in a fusion of intense gunplay with turn-based combat, item crafting, and a deep skill system. Each bullet shot, each grenade thrown, and each step taken will count towards failure or success. Rogue-lite progression Strengthen yourself by unlocking new skills after each mission. Buy new guns, upgrades, and useful items. Get stronger and defeat the enemies! Unique enemies and boss battles Dozens of strange abominations can be encountered; from zombies to mutated creatures, infested animals, living plants, weaponized machinery, and many more. Every stage features a unique selection of enemies, complete with a boss battle at the end. Defeating a stage boss will require clever use of strategy, learning the enemies' weaknesses, and utilizing the right skills at the right time. Crafting System Unlock crafting to combine items into new or stronger ones. Recovery items and ammunition for a secret weapon can be assembled whenever you are not in an active battle. Plan ahead of time to make sure you have the edge in combat when you need it the most. Encounter random events: every run is different Meet other characters, open chests with valuable loot, buy stat-altering drinks, and defeat thieving little rodents among many other events that can be encountered at random. No two runs will be the same. Utilize an arsenal of weapons and skills Unlock unique guns, each with their own benefits and downsides; use throwables to blast enemies into pieces, blind them, stun them or set them all on fire. Olivenia can also learn hundreds of different active and passive skills. Every gun has its own set of active skills, like unlocking the potential of rapid fire for the pistol, or birdshot to hit all enemies at once with the shotgun, supplemented by a huge number of passives that boost your defenses.
